blocks.text: SAN ILDEFONSO, Ilocos Sur — Cemetery visitors in nearby Magsingal town are being urged to bring reusable items, avoid single-use plastics and properly dispose of their trash as the local government promotes a zero-waste observance of Undas 2026. The zero-waste campaign seeks to reduce garbage generated during the annual influx of people visiting cemeteries and memorial parks to pay their respects to departed loved ones. The local government reminded the public that honoring the dead should also mean showing care for the environment by keeping burial grounds and surrounding public spaces clean.
